title: Practitioner note
points: SB 132 (June 2025) extends California's PTE elective tax through the 2030 tax year — it was set to expire after 2025.
For 2026 onward, a late or underpaid June 15 prepayment no longer disqualifies the election (it used to).
But the owner's PTE credit is reduced by 12.5% of that owner's share of the amount due but unpaid by June 15.
